top_signal.title: Looking for a Business Partner/Investor to Help Grow an Existing Healthcare Company
top_signal.summary: I’m an entrepreneur currently building a healthcare services company focused on early intervention and developmental services for children.  The business is already established, registered as an LLC in Pennsylvania, and we have a **signed provider contract in place with an established organization**. So this isn’t just an idea I’m trying to get off the ground. A lot of the foundational work has already been completed.  At this stage, my biggest challenge is capital.  I’m looking for a serious business partner who can bring investment capital and ideally some business or operational experience to the table. The immediate goal is to fund provider recruitment, onboarding, staffing infrastructure, and working capital so we can begin scaling operations under our existing agreement.  I’m targeting approximately $100,000 in capital, although I’m open to discussing different investment amounts and partnership structures.  The company was established in 2025 and is still in its early operating stage. While much of the administrative work can be handled remotely, the actual healthcare services are delivered in person. I’m open to working with someone outside Pennsylvania, including internationally, provided they understand the U.S. business environment.  I’m offering the opportunity to discuss a genuine equity partnership, with ownership determined by the capital invested, expertise contributed, and responsibilities assumed.
